To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we have proposed a novel Transformer network that can be quadratically large, and that we have evaluated this novel network on three datasets and shown that it outperforms the state of the art.
we propose a class Transformer-QL networks, in which, the length of the context grows at best quadratically in the computational and memory resources used.

Transformer-QL networks are a class of Transformer networks, which are quadratically large, can be implemented with the existing Transformer network architecture, can be trained with existing Transformer training techniques and are more powerful than the existing state of the art models.
In summary, our research is concerned with
a new architecture that can make the context length of Transformer network quadratically large.
a class of transformer models that can be scaled up quadratically with respect to the context length and computational power.
the question of whether a transformer network can be made large enough for a long range language modeling task.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the Transformer-QL network can provide a quadratic growth in the context length with the memory and computation power used.

the Transformer-QL is the first Transformer architecture that can have a quadratic growth in context length, which makes it a step forward in the quest of making the transformer network quadratically large.
Transformer-QL is a step towards making transformer networks quadratically large.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
Transformer-QL networks are quadratically large, and they can be used to model long range dependencies.

, Transformer-QL can achieve better performance than a transformer network of the same memory size, and a transformer network of a given memory size can be replaced by a Transformer-QL network of a smaller memory size, while still achieving a better performance.
, Transformer-QL can be used to build a transformer model with very long context length, which is a step towards making the transformer network quadratically large.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the Transformer network can scale quadratically in the number of previous tokens.
